summary: Iteration 7 (Phase A 'delight & hooks' polish) testing PASSED on backend and mostly PASSED on frontend. Backend (9/9 in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py, 1.91s): PATCH /api/brand-memory correctly accepts {colors:[hex..], tone:'Warm & Artisanal'} — the exact payload sent by app/agent.tsx applyVibe(). Verified end-to-end on a THROWAWAY account: (a) unauthenticated GET/PATCH both return 401; (b) fresh user gets {enabled:true, tone:'', keywords:[], colors:[]} defaults; (c) PATCH with colors+tone persists (verified via follow-up GET); (d) a second PATCH with a different vibe overwrites cleanly; (e) server correctly caps colors to 8 and tone to 60 chars per server.py:471-482; (f) partial PATCH (tone-only) leaves colors and keywords untouched — good behavior for the Apply-vibe flow, which sends colors+tone without wiping keywords. Regression: demo GET /api/brand-memory still returns the required {enabled, tone, keywords, colors} shape. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, demo login): (A) Smart-suggestion on /agent WORKS perfectly. Typing 'A cozy neighborhood coffee shop with single-origin beans and a warm artisanal vibe' surfaces testID='smart-suggestion' with vibe label 'Warm & Artisanal', a 5-swatch coffee-toned palette, apply-vibe-button, and suggest-template link ('Coffee Shop'). Tapping apply-vibe-button flips it cleanly to 'Vibe applied' state (checkmark icon + brand-colored bg) — confirmed via inner_text 'Vibe applied' after tap. This is the PATCH /api/brand-memory call — no error visible in console. Changing idea to a fitness prompt correctly re-labels vibe to 'Bold & Energetic' (keyword inference works). Run button and suggestion coexist as required — agent-run-button remained tappable but was NOT tapped (spec: no paid image gen). Cmd/Ctrl+Enter hint text renders on web. (B) Studio: demo account has 3 seeded brand kits (better than iter6 preview where it had 0), so empty-try-agent / empty-new-kit CTAs were not rendered — verified as expected. The 3 brand-kit-<id> tiles render correctly. (C) Brand-kit header 'kit-share-story' present as icon on the right of the header — tapping it navigates to /story/<kit_id>?title=<name>. (D) Creation Story screen (/story/<id>) renders CORRECTLY: 'Creation Story' header, story-back button, composed card with hero LinearGradient, 'MY NEW BRAND' eyebrow, brand name 'Root Discipline', italic tagline, 5-swatch palette row, '2-day streak' badge (streak count from /api/usage), 'Made with CreatorForge' + 'Idea → Brand in minutes' footer, and story-share-button at the bottom. story-back correctly navigates back to /brand-kit/<id>. UNCERTAIN — story-share-button tap did not produce visible export/toast: 5 different click dispatch methods (page.click force=True, page.mouse.down/up on bounding box, PointerEvent pointerdown+pointerup, MouseEvent click via dispatchEvent, focus+Enter) all confirm the DOM 'click' event fires on the underlying <button> (tag=BUTTON, aria-disabled=None, elementsFromPoint shows button on top of stack — no overlay), yet NO side effects occur: aria-busy never flips to 'true', button text never swaps to spinner, no 'Creation story ready' or 'Could not create story image' toast appears, no anchor.click download event fires, no promise rejection is captured. Meaning share() itself never runs under Playwright, despite the click event reaching the button node. Same Button component works fine elsewhere (subscribe-button in iter6, apply-vibe-button on same screen, kit-share-story that led us here). Could be a Playwright/RN-web synthetic-event edge case OR a real bug where the outer bottom-bar view is capturing pointer events. Could NOT reproduce with certainty as an actual user-facing bug — main agent should verify manually in a real browser. All visual + navigation aspects of Creation Story are correct and match the spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Under Playwright, browser click event fires on the button element but Button.onPress → share() does not execute — no aria-busy flip, no toast, no anchor download event, no console error. Same Button component (Pressable-based) works elsewhere (subscribe-button, apply-vibe-button, kit-share-story). Could be a Playwright quirk; needs manual verification in a real browser to confirm PNG export actually downloads and toast appears. If it also fails for real users, likely candidates: (a) react-native-view-shot on web hanging on the LinearGradient hero without a proper crossOrigin config, (b) an outer absolutely-positioned bar container blocking Pressable's pointerdown/pointerup timing.
ui_bugs.priority: MEDIUM (unverified — visuals are correct; only the export handler is in question)

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iters 1-6: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' still emitted. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Card/Button shadows).
Carry-over: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — Reference: /app/frontend/app/brand-kit/[id].tsx:268 (watermark View pointerEvents="none") and other overlay wrappers.
Warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' — cosmetic on web, expected. Reference: RN-web animations.

action_items: MANUAL VERIFICATION NEEDED: Open /story/<any-kit-id> in a real browser (Chrome/Safari desktop or mobile), tap 'Share my story' and confirm (a) a PNG download starts (filename creatorforge-story-<name>.png) and (b) a 'Creation story ready to share!' toast appears. If it fails there too, investigate why share() isn't firing — candidates: (1) react-native-view-shot 4.0.3 hanging with LinearGradient on web (try passing useCORS/allowTaint to html2canvas via captureRef options, or replacing LinearGradient with a static CSS gradient inside the captured card), (2) the absolutely-positioned bottom bar container in /app/frontend/app/story/[id].tsx:128-130 intercepting pointer events for the Button — try adding pointerEvents="box-none" to the bar wrapper and/or moving the Button above the ScrollView.

OPTIONAL (carry-over from iters 1-6): migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents in ui.tsx and app/brand-kit/[id].tsx (watermark line 268 uses pointerEvents="none" as a prop).

MINOR: In /app/frontend/src/utils/suggest.ts, both 'Warm & Artisanal' and 'Bold & Energetic' map to category 'Local Business', so the suggest-template link always shows the first Local Business template ('Coffee Shop') for both vibes. Consider category-per-vibe or a richer picker so the template also reflects the vibe (e.g. 'Fitness Studio' when the vibe is Bold & Energetic).

NICE-TO-HAVE: The applied-vibe UI compares appliedVibe (string) against suggestion.vibe.label. When the user changes their idea to a different vibe after applying, the 'Vibe applied' state is lost visually (correctly), but there's no persistent visual reminder that they DID save a vibe to brand memory. Consider a small chip on /agent (or reuse agent-memory-chip) that reflects the currently-saved tone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:471-483 patch_brand_memory correctly gates each field with its own type check ('enabled' → bool, 'tone' → str[:60], 'keywords'/'colors' → isinstance list, per-item .strip() + truncation) — safe against bad clients. Returns updated brand_memory in canonical shape.

frontend /app/frontend/app/agent.tsx applyVibe() correctly wraps api.updateBrandMemory in try/catch and only flips appliedVibe state optimistically — no UI regression on network error, though it would be nice to toast on failure.

frontend /app/frontend/src/utils/suggest.ts is a pure client function — zero network cost, matches spec 'zero AI cost'. Ordering keywords are reasonable but a tie always favors DEFAULT_VIBE if bestScore stays 0; consider tie-breaking by keyword-length or explicit ordering.

frontend /app/frontend/app/story/[id].tsx uses cardRef via useRef on a plain <View collapsable={false}> — good; collapsable=false is required for react-native-view-shot to keep the node addressable. LinearGradient inside is the only web-taint risk factor for html2canvas.

frontend /app/frontend/src/utils/exporter.ts:17-27 correctly branches on Platform.OS === 'web' to use data-uri + anchor.click download. No cleanup issue. On native it uses tmpfile + Sharing — spec-compliant.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — smart-suggestion, apply-vibe (state flip + PATCH), studio nav, kit-share-story navigation, Creation Story visual composition (name, palette, tagline, streak badge, footer), story-back all VERIFIED. story-share-button PNG export flow is UNVERIFIED under Playwright (click reaches DOM but Pressable onPress didn't fire) — needs a manual real-browser check.

seed_data_creation: 1 throwaway user (tester+iter7_*@creatorforge.app) created for backend PATCH/GET tests. No image generations consumed. Demo account read-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-7 verified endpoints: PATCH /api/brand-memory accepts partial {enabled?, tone?[str<=60], keywords?[list<=12 strings], colors?[list<=8 strings]} and returns {brand_memory:{enabled,tone,keywords,colors}}. 401 without JWT. New frontend testIDs: smart-suggestion (agent screen suggestion card), apply-vibe-button (inside smart-suggestion), suggest-template (link next to apply-vibe-button), creation-tip (visible only while agent is running), agent-share-story (link at bottom of completed agent result — only visible after full agent run, not exercised), story-back and story-share-button (on /story/[id].tsx). Kit header now has kit-share-story icon that navigates to /story/<kit_id>?title=<name>. Studio empty-state testIDs empty-try-agent + empty-new-kit exist but only render when demo has 0 brand kits — in this env demo has 3 kits so empty state was not exercised. UNCERTAIN: story-share-button onPress does not fire under Playwright despite click reaching DOM (5 dispatch methods tried, all fail identically). Needs manual browser confirmation — if the export/toast works for a real user, this can be ignored; otherwise investigate react-native-view-shot on web with LinearGradient and/or the absolute-positioned bottom bar in /app/frontend/app/story/[id].tsx:128.
rca_of_issue: story-share-button dead-tap under Playwright — RCA (partial): DOM 'click' event reaches the underlying <button data-testid="story-share-button"> (verified with an installed 'click' capture listener that fired 'CLICK fired on button'). React state on the Button component (aria-busy, spinner-vs-text) never transitions after the click, so the Pressable's onPress handler (which would call setBusy(true) → exportView → toast) is never invoked. The DOM stack at the button center shows [textDiv, innerView, BUTTON.story-share-button, barContainerDiv, scrollViewContentDiv] — no overlay. Possible causes to investigate: (1) react-native-web Pressable synthetic-event system requiring specific pointerType/isTrusted flags that Playwright's mouse events don't set; if this were the cause, real user taps in Chrome should still work. (2) The Button component's Pressable is inside a ScrollView-adjacent absolutely-positioned bar (/app/frontend/app/story/[id].tsx:128-130 { position: 'absolute', left:0, right:0, bottom:0 }) — but with the ScrollView above and no explicit pointerEvents='box-none' on the bar wrapper, RN-web may resolve responder capture inconsistently on this specific composition. Reproduction: mobile viewport 375x667 → demo login → /studio → tap first brand-kit tile → tap kit-share-story icon (or direct-navigate /story/<kit_id>) → tap Share my story. Expected: PNG download + 'Creation story ready to share!' toast. Observed under Playwright: click event fires, then nothing. Mitigation candidates: (a) add pointerEvents='box-none' to the bar wrapper, (b) move the Share button INSIDE the ScrollView, (c) verify captureRef doesn't hang by testing with a simple exportView(document.body ref) on web.
